source_motivation.title: Spiking Neural Networks for Temporal Processing: Status Quo and Future Prospects
source_motivation.use: Motivates multi-timescale temporal evaluation; this matrix does not claim to reproduce the paper's four tasks because their full definitions and implementation were not independently inspected.

benchmark_alignment.neurobench: Separate hardware-independent algorithm results from deployed-system results.
benchmark_alignment.mlperf_tiny_v1_4: Use its continuous streaming/idle-listening and calibrated-energy measurement principles; the synthetic fast-event task is not the official audio workload or an MLPerf submission.

oaks_acl_2026.name: Online Adaptation to Continual Knowledge Streams
oaks_acl_2026.license_scope: Adobe Research License: noncommercial research/teaching only; excludes commercial product development or other commercial-gain activity.
oaks_acl_2026.caveat: Reconcile OAKS-Novel question counts and exact current dataset manifest before paper-score reproduction. OAKS uses natural-language chunked contexts and per-chunk answer labels; T10 is a distinct structured bitemporal valid_at/known_at exact-oracle task. The two scores must remain separate.

execution_state.generator_scope: Implemented Rust task generators: T1 always-on sparse event/quiet idle; T2 delayed cue; T3/T4 multi-timescale forecasting/change-point; T5 irregular/missingness; T6 selective retention/invalidation; T7 phase prediction; T8 BrainTrace DMS task semantics; T9 BrainTrace evidence accumulation; T10 bitemporal continual-knowledge stream. All have deterministic generation, canonical SHA-256 digests, semantic verifiers and evaluator-held seed/config replay checks. The OAKS external adapter, streaming runner, OS-level oracle isolation, signed receipts, real-dataset adapter, model baselines and system measurements remain unimplemented.

seed_bound_regeneration.note: Each verifier recomputes canonical SHA-256 and checks task semantics, then regenerates the expected task/oracle from evaluator-held seed/config metadata. The evaluator must protect those seeds/configurations; the candidate never receives them.

workload_contract.sample_semantics: Causal observations; no future samples; elapsed simulated time is explicit.
workload_contract.oracle_separation: Public task and oracle are still generated/returned in one process; digest verification detects content mutation only relative to a protected commitment and does not authenticate or isolate the oracle.
workload_contract.stream_id_semantics: Deterministic 64-bit pairing identifier only; not cryptographic and not tamper evidence.
workload_contract.canonical_encoding: Versioned little-endian encoding with domain separation; SHA-256 produced by the sha2 crate.

reproduction_blockers: OAKS-Novel question count differs between current code README (435) and dataset README (870); reconcile manifest/counting.
Use official per-chunk answer evaluator and exact source split/aggregation semantics.
Do not use restricted OAKS assets for commercial product development absent a separate license.

claim_ceiling: Results apply only to declared workloads, splits, implementations, and hardware. They do not establish consciousness, general intelligence, universal superiority, or neuromorphic efficiency when measured only on conventional CPU/GPU.

BrainTrace.dms_task: 8-direction delayed match-to-sample with 1,000 ms delay and spiking population input.
BrainTrace.role: Online-learning and long-horizon credit-assignment competitor; not a drop-in inference-only architecture.
BrainTrace.code_audit_status: Public DMS script inspected at pinned commit. Paper-to-script exact revision correspondence remains unverified.
known_replication_controls: DMS script samples with NumPy global RNG and does not visibly reset a per-replicate seed in the inspected entry path.
The inspected training loop iterates generated batches until a training accuracy threshold and does not show a separate held-out confirmatory test split.
Reproduction must use independent seed resets, grouped/locked development and confirmatory trials, and one-shot confirmatory evaluation.

paper_reported_complexity.pp_prop_trace_memory: O(B*N) for batch size B and neuron count N according to the Nature Communications article.
paper_reported_complexity.d_rtrl_trace_memory: O(B*P) for batch size B and parameter count P; dense recurrent P may scale quadratically with neuron count.

pp_prop_vs_d_rtrl_lif_gesture.scope: Paper-specific LIF Gesture experiment. Literature reference only; not Symthaea measurements.

paper_reported_complexity.bptt_sequence_memory: Paper reports memory increasing with sequence length and a GPU run failure at 400 steps for its specific experiment.
paper_reported_complexity.caveat: pp-prop is a factorized/approximated trace; its approximation quality can depend on firing statistics and network depth. Do not report it as an exact D-RTRL/BPTT gradient.

STDL.publication: Ma et al., IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems 37(9), 4597-4611 (2026-09)

source_findings.spatial_partition: LocalResNet calls an auxiliary classifier at configured stage/block boundaries, backpropagates the local loss and detaches the backbone activation before later stages; final classifier loss is also backpropagated.
source_findings.auxiliary_context: mem-configured AuxNetwork can include selected downstream layers. ResNet18 mem_1800 selects [6,7,8] from local boundary 1 and [6,8] from boundary 3; config names must not be mistaken for measured byte budgets.
source_findings.temporal_boundary: SpkModel resets state per forward call, loops over time_window, and LIFNode supports detach_mem/detach_reset. Example run.sh STDL configs enable both detach flags.
source_findings.training_hardware: main_train.py asserts CUDA availability and wraps the model with DataParallel().cuda().
source_findings.checkpoint_selection: CIFAR10/CIFAR100/SVHN/CIFAR10DVS/HARDVS load test splits into val_loader; training loop evaluates loader every epoch and selects best checkpoint. Separate dev and one-shot confirmatory splits required.
source_findings.imageNet: ImageNet valdir also used for checkpoint selection; treat as dev for strict reproduction.
source_findings.memory_reporting: Allocated/peak CUDA allocated memory logging is present but not full peak host/device/system footprint or energy measurement.
source_findings.seed_reporting: Default seed 9 and Python/NumPy/PyTorch/CUDA seeding exists; multi-seed paper protocol still needs explicit verification.
source_findings.framework_lock: No complete dependency lock found in inspected repository snapshot; lock PyTorch/torchvision/CUDA/cuDNN/data transforms for reproduction.
